description.summary: This leftover turkey corn chowder comes together in about 30 minutes and is the most delicious way to use up that leftover Thanksgiving turkey. It uses both cream-style corn and whole-kernel sweet corn. Also works with leftover shredded chicken or rotisserie chicken.

ingredients.ingredient: shredded leftover fully cooked turkey (may sub shredded leftover fully cooked chicken)
low sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth

preparation.step: In a large stock pot combine cream style corn, whole kernel corn, broth, celery, bell peppers, potatoes, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are tender and easily pierced with a fork.
Stir in turkey and season with salt and pepper. When turkey is heated through, serve and garnish with fresh parsley or thyme as desired.
Note: This also works with leftover shredded chicken or rotisserie chicken.
